name: radare2
title: radare2 (r2mcp)
description: Reverse engineering with radare2 through its official MCP server r2mcp: open a binary, analyze, list functions, imports, strings and sections, disassemble, decompile (r2's pdc), cross references. Binaries are read from the folder mounted at /work (open_file takes /work/<file>); r2mcp refuses paths outside /work. No network.
license: MIT (r2mcp) AND LGPL-3.0-only (radare2; some plugins GPL-3.0, Apache-2.0, BSD)

mounts.description: The folder with the binaries to analyze (read-only is enough)

notes: radare2's own sandbox is on (no shell, no sockets, no file writes) and the raw run_command / run_javascript tools are off. The sql tool needs the r2xsql plugin, which is not included.
